title: File:Fuji Hokuroku Stadium.jpg
claims: The image is a vertical aerial view of the athletics stadium inside Fuji Hokuroku Park, showing the red running track, grass infield, low grandstand, large car parks to the north and west, access roads and surrounding woodland.

The Commons file identifies Fuji Hokuroku Stadium; the FUJI100mi finish is Fuji Hokuroku Park Fujisan GX Stadium at 167.0 km. The aerial was taken in 2021, so it shows the venue footprint but cannot prove the 2026 finish arch, race-day layout or the later stadium name.

The author is the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (国土地理院); the file is licensed CC BY 4.0; the original is 1,005 x 1,008 pixels and 757,125 bytes; the photograph is dated 2021-05-09 and derived from the GSI aerial-photo service.
The route page uses a 960 x 963 copy of 319,235 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source; attribution is required.
